title: AMZYA under construction page
question: Which design should become the page? Pick one, or ask for another set.

options.label: The building section
options.thesis: The page is a building under construction. Finished floors are your 5 services, the top floors are still in scaffolding, and the ground floor has 3 entrances: WhatsApp, Email and the link.
options.viewport: A full-height cutaway of a building, with the headline in the unbuilt upper floors and the contact doors at street level.
options.risk: The most literal idea of the three, and it needs careful drawing to feel premium.

options.label: The mark under erection
options.thesis: Your logo mark is the building. It fills the screen, half finished in solid burgundy and half still in steel construction lines.
options.viewport: A giant mark on a dark ground, with English on the left, Arabic on the right and the contact row along the bottom.
options.risk: Bold and very brand-led, but says less about the services at first glance.

options.label: The site hoarding
options.thesis: The fence around a Dubai site, as a web page. A run of printed burgundy, white and pattern panels, with a site door in the fence that holds the contact details.
options.viewport: A full-width hoarding with huge bilingual lettering across its panels and a door in the middle holding the 3 actions.
options.risk: Feels most like a real site, but must not look like a photo of a fence with no working parts.
